invariants.statement: Approval canonical task/action bindings cannot be rewritten during consumption
Kernel approval resume preserves the same Task, Step and FEET route and a consumed Approval cannot replay
Unknown external effect never permits blind unsafe retry
Task completion requires an IMMUNE-owned verified completion manifest
Verified terminal completion closes Task, Step, and FEET route consistently
VOICE never upgrades tool/effect success into verified completion
Retrieved memory never silently becomes current truth
Recovery reconstructs next work without replaying external commands
Runtime readiness percentages are derived from canonical evidence-bearing state and 100 percent requires consistent VERIFIED completion
Multi-step plans preserve canonical Step dependencies and only dependency-satisfied Steps become READY
